verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the Document AI solution page. It positions the product for compliance-first organizations needing secure on-premises deployment, and notes Mistral sells self-hosted enterprise deployments. That gives indirect control over where data lives, but only through an enterprise self-hosting route, not a user-selectable storage region. Missing for 10: documented region/residency selection for the hosted API (e.g. EU/US), data-storage location policy for uploaded documents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
